text: `git stash` to test a baseline in a repo where another agent was concurrently committing nearly clobbered its in-progress edits; a shared-worktree check (or a 'never stash a shared tree, build the baseline in a temp clone' rule) would have prevented it.

br_deliver refuses when the assignee holds any other in_progress bead, so two concurrent agents defaulting to the same `aditya` assignee deadlock each other; per-agent assignee identities (or a per-bead delivery check) would have prevented it.
